title: Buckling of a simply supported square plate in uniaxial compression
source: Bryan's plate buckling stress σ_cr = k π² E/(12 (1 − ν²)) (t/b)² with k = 4 for a square plate simply supported on four edges (G. H. Bryan, Proc. London Math. Soc. 22:54–67, 1891; Timoshenko & Gere 1961, §9.2): b = 50, t = 0.5, E = 1000, ν = 0.3, σ_cr = 0.361524
